primary_user: UK local councillor / scrutiny committee overseeing fuel poverty spend
painful_workflow: Signing off Winter Fuel Payment, Warm Home Discount, and Household Support Fund with no proof which households actually got warmer
current_workaround: Vouchers and BACS transfers; post-hoc audits that cannot show heat outcomes
imported_mechanism: Match local rooftop solar surplus to nearby fuel-poor households; AI scores case notes; deterministic solver allocates; GBP token settles; hashed kWh on public ledger
mechanism_origin: Accountability infrastructure + programmable settlement, not energy trading
core_computation: Nine-factor deterministic need scoring with published weights; pure allocation function with SHA-256 digests; AI only for note parsing and post-hoc plain-English reports
last_mile_action: Councillor deposits into winter pot, settles allocations on chain, prints committee-ready report with explorer link
visible_transformation: Live pot balance and per-household (hashed) energy delivery a non-technical MP can verify
sponsor_dependency: EasyA Parliament venue; optional Anthropic for reports; no sponsor cloud required for offline demo
technical_risk: Simulated meters; testnet GBP token not regulated money; local matching is settlement/accounting not physical grid rewiring
why_now: Fuel Poverty Strategy 2026 and Warm Homes Plan push outcome traceability; Parliament audience obsessed with accountability and energy
killer_demo: Deposit live → run engine → settle SolacePound txs → plain-English report + explorer link in under four minutes
hard_to_fake_advantage: Tested firewall: allocation engine cannot import AI/network/clock/random; privacy HMAC on recipients; doctor checks DB vs on-chain ledger parity
